purpose: Advance Sprint S1.3 by freezing gross battery-energy, rated-power minimum-loaded-bus and continuous pack-current requirements while keeping exact cell/pack implementation open.

change_control.rule: PB-05 inherits PB-04 unless a PB-05 decision explicitly supersedes an inherited value. Any later change to a PB-05 frozen value requires PB-06 or an explicitly linked engineering change record; no silent overwrite is allowed.

summary: X8 coaxial / eight independent propulsion channels
18S battery architecture / 75.6 V full charge / <=80 V outer input ceiling
>=10 min nominal mission target and >=10 min hover-equivalent sizing target
>=70 A continuous DC and >=200 A for >=3 s per-ESC capability
>=4.8 kW continuous and >=11.5 kW short-duration per-ESC input capability
>=125 A RMS continuous phase current, >=265 A RMS for >=3 s and >=375 A instantaneous phase peak
phase-current measurement range at least -400 A to +400 A
power-up/reset DISARMED and no automatic re-arm after fault

clarifications.meaning: Nominal mission energy may consume no more than 80% of gross rated pack energy at the sizing reference. This is not the final BMS SOC cutoff or firmware landing threshold.

PB-04's 66.6 V convention is retained as a system-level 18S/3.7 V reference. Current Molicel candidate cells are rated 3.6 V nominal and would therefore be 64.8 V nameplate nominal if selected. Exact pack nominal labeling remains implementation-dependent and must be reconciled under change control when the cell MPN freezes.

new_frozen_decisions.reference_condition: 85 kg nominal payload / 165 kg nominal MTOW / >=10 min hover-equivalent first-order mission sizing
new_frozen_decisions.rationale: PB-04 gives ~3.574 kWh terminal mission energy and ~4.467 kWh gross energy before battery internal losses when 20% of gross energy is reserved. Current high-rate 21700 candidate DCR screens add roughly 0.26-0.30 kWh over the 10-minute nominal reference. >=5.0 kWh is adopted as the rated pack-energy floor while exact cell/topology remains open.

54.0 V is adopted as the minimum loaded bus at which full rated power must be supported. Below this point the vehicle/ESC must derate or terminate the mission according to S1.4 policy. The hard cell/BMS cutoff remains exact-pack-specific and OPEN.

The 180 kg maximum-MTOW hover reference is ~24.420 kW. At the frozen 54.0 V rated-power floor this is ~452.2 A. Approximately 10% design allowance gives ~497 A, rounded upward to >=500 A continuous pack capability.

battery_candidate_disposition.primary_qualification_candidate: Molicel INR-21700-P50B in an 18S16P calculation topology
battery_candidate_disposition.mass_optimization_candidate: Molicel INR-21700-P60B in an 18S14P calculation topology
battery_candidate_disposition.mature_alternate: Molicel INR-21700-P45B in an 18S18P calculation topology
battery_candidate_disposition.candidate_only_warning: Topology counts are engineering screens against >=5.0 kWh minimum cell energy and >=500 A pack capability. They are not production pack releases.

remaining_s1_critical_open_items: exact battery cell/pouch MPN, pack topology, mass and usable SOC
low-SOC/cold/aged sag correlation and hard BMS cutoff behavior
PWM frequency/current ripple final closure after exact motor inductance evidence
exact 150 V MOSFET MPN and parallel count
current-sense implementation, DC-link, precharge and thermal architecture
anti_hallucination_rule: PB-05 values are controlled product design requirements supported by calculation and primary cell data. Candidate pack topologies are not physical pack validation, endurance proof, thermal qualification or flight qualification.
